meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 启动后，Claude 会创建一个5人敌对团队（怀疑者、验证者、研究者、架构师、创意挑战者），成员相互攻击对方的方案，只保留经得起批判的见解，然后强制交给一个规划任务生成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”、“hpp”、“adversarial plan”等触发词时，或主动要求进行对抗性批判规划时触发。

say.text: 启动hyperplan模式，分析我们的项目计划。
say.note: Claude 会组建5人团队开始对抗性批判。

say.text: 用敌对团队审视我的架构设计。
say.note: 架构师和怀疑者将主导攻击复杂度。

say.text: 执行cross-critique planning，检查用户需求。
say.note: 所有成员会针对需求提出批判性发现。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude orchestrates a 5-member adversarial team (Skeptic, Validator, Researcher, Architect, Creative Challenger). Members attack each other's findings; only insights surviving critique are distilled and handed to a planner for executable plan formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', or similar keywords, or explicitly request adversarial cross-critique planning.

say_en.text: Start hyperplan mode on our project plan.
say_en.note: Claude spawns the 5-member team and begins critique.

say_en.text: Use hostile team to review my architecture.
say_en.note: Architect and Skeptic will attack over-engineering.

say_en.text: Run cross-critique planning for user requirements.
say_en.note: All members generate adversarial findings on the requirements.
